tools.name: get_neighborhoods
tools.title: Get Turin neighborhoods
tools.description: List Turin neighborhoods for students with average rent, safety, transport and student profile. Optional slug filter returns a single neighborhood.

slug.description: Optional neighborhood slug (e.g. 'san-salvario'). If omitted, returns all.

tools.name: get_investor_zones
tools.title: Get Turin investor zones
tools.description: List Turin real-estate investor zones with entry prices, urban renewal projects and market metrics. Return figures projections are NOT included (confidential, memorandum only). Optional slug filter returns one zone.

slug.description: Optional zone slug. If omitted, returns all zones.

tools.name: contact_jungle_rent
tools.title: Contact Jungle Rent
tools.description: Return the primary contact channels for Jungle Rent (WhatsApp with founder Lorenzo, email, website). Use when a user asks how to get in touch, book a call, or send an inquiry.
